title: Is a driven oscillator's displacement response largest at its natural frequency?

assumptions.statement: Driving at the undamped natural frequency w0 = sqrt(k/m) maximizes RMS displacement.
assumptions.origin: Proposed by the hypothesis seat (rain-james, scripted) as the common simplification under test.

assumptions.statement: The lab's 10-second numerical template window (scientific/example.ts) measures where a driven oscillator responds most.
assumptions.origin: The lab's own existing numerical template; its compiler already states that the RMS includes transients.

exploratory_episode.note: One fixed exploratory system (w0 = 2 rad/s, gamma = 0.2 1/s, damping ratio 0.1). Its runs motivate the correction; they are not the test of it.

correction.statement: Steady displacement peaks at w_r = sqrt(w0^2 - 2 gamma^2), below w0, and a response comparison needs a window of at least 8/gamma.
correction.status_of_physics: Textbook result for linear damped oscillators. What is tested here is whether this lab's protocol catches and confirms it on unseen systems, not whether it is new.

held_out_test.seed: unsigned 32-bit integer from the first 8 hex digits of sha256(protocol_sha256 + ':held-out:' + i), i = 0..11, protocol_sha256 being the canonical-JSON SHA-256 of this file
held_out_test.grid: drive ratios u = 0.80, 0.82, ..., 1.04 (13 points) of each system's w0
held_out_test.long_window: max(8/gamma, 20 periods of the lowest drive), timestep at 2% of the fastest rate
held_out_test.template_window: 10 s, dt 0.01 s, sample every 10 steps
held_out_test.measured_peak: the grid ratio with the largest RMS displacement in the long window (u_long) and in the template window (u_template)

metrics.runs_verified_share: share of the backend records that re-verify

criteria_A2_misleads.note: supported means the template window misplaces the peak (A2 is refuted); failed means it does not (A2 stands).

reporting: The exploratory runs, every held-out run digest, both criteria outcomes and the claim ledger are written to docs/benchmarks/rain-collaboration/. A failed or inconclusive outcome is reported as such.
